title: Rabbi Simon, Brother of Rabbi Yehudah bar Zavdi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra, beginning of chapter 3, and in Bereshit Rabbah 85:13, saying in Rabbi’s name: “This infant — so long as he is cast out in the market, his father and mother are believed concerning him.” In Kiddushin 4:2 the statement is attributed to Rabbi Abba, brother of Rabbi Yehudah bar Zavdi; see his entry.

notes.text: In the consulted Bereshit Rabbah 85:13, Rabbi Simon, brother of Rabbi Yehudah bar Zavdi, reports the ruling in the name of Rav. The notice has Rabbi.
